executed.title: Ordered physical transform and source/derived coordinate mapping
executed.label: executed by candidate
executed.rationale: The correction makes NGFF list order and source-to-derived transform direction explicit. Choose noncommuting scale/translation and a right-angle affine so reversing the order or omitting the inverse is observable.
executed.expected: NGFF scale then translation maps [2,3] to [101,-1]; source_to_derived maps [2,3] to [2,4]; its inverse returns [2,3]. Applying translation before scale gives a different world coordinate.
executed.code:
import json

case = {
    "source_index": [2.0, 3.0],
    "ngff_scale": [0.5, 2.0],
    "ngff_translation": [100.0, -7.0],
    "source_to_derived": [[0.0, -1.0, 5.0], [1.0, 0.0, 2.0], [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]],
}

def scale_then_translate(point, scale, translation):
    return [point[i] * scale[i] + translation[i] for i in range(len(point))]

def apply_2d(matrix, point):
    x, y = point
    return [matrix[0][0] * x + matrix[0][1] * y + matrix[0][2],
            matrix[1][0] * x + matrix[1][1] * y + matrix[1][2]]

def inverse_orthogonal_affine(matrix, point):
    a, b, tx = matrix[0]
    c, d, ty = matrix[1]
    det = a * d - b * c
    x, y = point[0] - tx, point[1] - ty
    return [(d * x - b * y) / det, (-c * x + a * y) / det]

p = case["source_index"]
world = scale_then_translate(p, case["ngff_scale"], case["ngff_translation"])
q = apply_2d(case["source_to_derived"], p)
back = inverse_orthogonal_affine(case["source_to_derived"], q)
assert world == [101.0, -1.0]
assert q == [2.0, 4.0]
assert back == p
reverse_order = [(p[i] + case["ngff_translation"][i]) * case["ngff_scale"][i] for i in range(2)]
assert reverse_order != world
print("source index:", p)
print("NGFF scale then translation => world:", world)
print("source_to_derived => derived index:", q)
print("inverse export mapping => source index:", back)
print("translation then scale differs:", reverse_order != world)
print("frame-aware coordinate round-trip:", back == p)

scope_limits: Pure Python arithmetic on one 2D affine and one 2-axis scale/translation example.
The affine inverse routine is used for this orthogonal 90-degree transform only; it is not a generic matrix inverse or resampling implementation.
Does not parse NGFF, convert units, resolve pixel-center conventions, serialize an application frame, resample pixels, export a file, reopen a project, or establish viewer/application behavior.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Instrument reader and calibration fixtures
proposed_unexecuted.plan: For each supported fixture file, compare raw metadata, axis order, dtype, sample values and (calibration value, unit) through the pinned reader and application import service; include a #319-style unit regression fixture and conflicting-metadata cases.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: No unit/axis changes go unnoticed; unsupported ambiguity remains recoverable and cannot create an annotation frame by guesswork.

proposed_unexecuted.title: 3 GB bounded review benchmark
proposed_unexecuted.plan: On the 8-core/16 GB machine use representative tiled and compressed instrument files; measure visible-tile p95 latency, RSS, cache/in-flight memory, cancellation and progress under concurrent requests.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Evaluate proposed goals p95 <100 ms, RSS <4 GB and cancel <250 ms; report failures and actual workload rather than claiming these from component docs.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Frame-aware reopen after relocation and reader change
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Move the same source bytes to another path/machine, reopen the project under a changed reader version and metadata parse, and compare saved source hash, frame ID, raw metadata, correction operations and annotations.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Saved frame is preserved; new calibration interpretation requires a new explicit correction/frame ID; mismatching bytes remain unresolved absent explicit adoption.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Source-frame and derived-frame export round trip
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Export one annotation in its source frame and in a resampled derived frame. Verify manifest frame IDs and transform directions, forward-map the source geometry and inverse-map where defined. Test crop, flip, rotation, noninteger scale and changed output shape separately.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Coordinates match the declared frame within a format-specific tolerance; no requirement that derived-frame coordinates equal stored source indices.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Save and export interruption on local and shared storage
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Interrupt before/after CURRENT promotion and during export on local storage and the actual shared-storage system (SMB/NFS as used). Validate generations, directory flush behavior, retries, backups and partial-output cleanup.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Reopen sees a valid prior or complete new generation, never a partial committed state; share-specific ambiguity is reported.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Reference versus portable bundle relocation
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Move a referenced project and source, test matching/mismatching hashes, then repeat with explicit copied source data. Verify workstation path aliases and derived files.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: No silent relink on byte mismatch; portability trade-off and included content are visible.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Keyboard-only workflow and feedback
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Complete import, navigation, channel/display adjustment, point/polygon/mask editing, undo/redo, save/reopen/export with keyboard only and increased text scale.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: All actions reachable with visible focus; metadata and errors are legible text with recovery action and no color-only status.
